q: Fill in the gap: Neither of the boys has done ___ work.
The population of the earth is increasing at a tremendous rate and ___ out of control
e: Subject population singular, এবং and দিয়ে জোড়া লাগানো দ্বিতীয় অংশে একই subject-এর verb বসে, তাই soon will be সঠিক। অর্থ: পৃথিবীর জনসংখ্যা অসম্ভব হারে বাড়ছে এবং শিগগিরই নিয়ন্ত্রণের বাইরে চলে যাবে। They have become-এ pronoun ভুল (population-এর জন্য it), আর are soon going to be বহুবচন verb, যা singular subject-এর সাথে মেলে না। Why it will be কোনো অর্থই দেয় না।

q: Identify the correct sentence:
o: Neither Maruf nor his brothers was available.
Neither Maruf nor his brother were available.
Neither Maruf nor his brothers are available.
Neither Maruf nor his brothers is available.

q: Identify the correct sentence:
o: The Jury were unanimous in their decision.
The Jury were unanimous in its decision.
The Jury was unanimous in its decision.
The Jury was unanimous in their decision.
e: Jury একটি collective noun। দলটিকে যখন একটি অবিভক্ত একক হিসেবে দেখা হয়, তখন verb singular হয় এবং সর্বনাম its বসে। এখানে বিচারকমণ্ডলী সর্বসম্মত সিদ্ধান্ত দিয়েছেন, তাই was ও its শুদ্ধ। কিন্তু সদস্যরা আলাদা হয়ে গেলে (noun of multitude) verb ও pronoun বহুবচন হয়, যেমন The jury were divided in their opinions।

q: Fill in the blank: Both of the mice ____ underfed.

Questions 9 to 12 : For each question, find the appropriate English usage. 12) 'A list of books about sourcing fresh ingredients and cooking are in the file on the table.' Which correction should be made to this sentencе?
e: বাক্যের মূল subject হলো 'A list', যা একবচন, তাই verb হবে is, অর্থাৎ 'are' বদলে 'is' করতে হবে। 'of books about sourcing fresh ingredients and cooking' অংশটি কেবল list-কে বর্ণনা করছে, এটি subject নয়। ফলে books বা cooking বহুবচন বা দুটি জিনিস হলেও verb-এর বচন নির্ধারণে এগুলো গোনা হয় না। cooking-এর পরে বা file-এর পরে কমা দেওয়ার দরকার নেই, food যোগ করলে অর্থ বদলায় না, আর of-কে to করলে বাক্য ভুল হয়। একই নিয়ম: The box of chocolates is on the table, এখানেও subject 'box'।

q: The number of pages in this book _____ exactly three hundred.
The chairman, with all the members, _____ invited to the ceremony.
e: With, together with, along with, as well as, in addition to-এর মতো শব্দ দিয়ে কোনো noun যুক্ত হলে verb প্রথম কর্তার সঙ্গে মেলে। এখানে প্রথম কর্তা The chairman একবচন, তাই verb হবে was; with all the members অংশ verb-এর বচন বদলায় না। অতএব The chairman, with all the members, was invited to the ceremony শুদ্ধ। প্রথম noun বহুবচন হলে verb বহুবচন হতো।

q: Many a student _______ failed in the examination.
One-third of the employees ___ present in the office.
Neither of the answers ____ correct.
Which sentence is the correct one?
o: A number of serious diseases is creating alarming situation nowadays.
Every year a lot of children dies of cholera.
Many a man tries to become rich but only few can succeed.
The number of his mistakes are immeasurable.

q: It is you who ______________ to embrace change and adapt to new circumstances.
One third of the work _____ been finished.
Choose the correct sentence:
o: Each of the students were completed the assignment.
Each of the students has completed the assignment.
Each of the students had complete the assignment.
Each of the students have completed the assignment.
e: Each of, one of, any of, either of ও neither of-এর পরে বহুবচন noun থাকলেও subject একবচন ধরা হয়, তাই verb একবচন হয়। Each প্রত্যেককে আলাদাভাবে বোঝায়। তাই Each of the students has completed the assignment শুদ্ধ। উদাহরণ: One of the boys is absent। মনে রাখুন: have একবচন subject-এর সঙ্গে চলে না; were completed passive গঠন তৈরি করে, যা এখানে অর্থ ভেঙে দেয়; আর had complete-এ participle ভুল।

q: The Prime Minister, along with his ministers, ___ arrived.
e:
Along with, together with, as well as, with দিয়ে যুক্ত অংশ Subject-এর অংশ নয়। তাই Verb মূল Subject অনুযায়ী হয়। এখানে মূল Subject the Prime Minister একবচন, ফলে Verb has।
মনে রাখুন:
The teacher with his students is here.
My father along with my mother is coming.
Verb প্রথম Subject-এর সঙ্গে মেলে।

q: Either the manager or the assistant ___ responsible for the keys.
The principal, together with the teachers, _______ the assembly.
Choose the correct sentence.
o: Each of the students who filled out the admission form has appeared at the test.
Each of the students who filled out the admission form have appeared at the test.
Each of the student who filled out the admission form has appeared at the test.
Each of the students who filled out the admission form are appeared at the test.
e: Each of-এর পরে plural noun (the students) থাকে, কিন্তু মূল শব্দ Each singular, তাই verb-ও singular হয়: has appeared। অতএব Each of the students who filled out the admission form has appeared at the test শুদ্ধ। বাকি বাক্যে হয় are appeared ও have appeared দিয়ে plural verb দেওয়া হয়েছে, নয়তো Each of the student লিখে একবচন noun ব্যবহার করা হয়েছে, যা ভুল।

q: Sumaiya together with her sisters ___ in accomplishing the task.
